description: Compare your files against a git reference instead of HEAD
configuration.title: Git Branch Quick Diff
configuration.enabled.description: Use Git Branch Quick Diff as diff gutter instead of VSCode default. The file of the ref will be used as base for the comparison.
configuration.ref.description: Default ref to use for comparison when no workspace-specific ref is set. The actual ref used is stored per-workspace and can be changed with 'Set quick diff ref' command. Variable substitution can be used.
configuration.displayMode.description: Display mode for the changes view: list or tree.
configuration.defaultAction.description: Default action when clicking on a changed file: open diff (openChanges) or open file directly (openFile).
